subject: Re: MUSIQ kickoff — resourcing, incl. leaderboard build
body:
Lucia,

Resourcing proposal:

- Scoring API: Nikhil packages the run_predict_image path for Shipyard; Wei owns model validation against the published numbers. ~3 weeks to the 05-15 prototype.
- Benchmark leaderboard service: we're scoping and building this from scratch — there's nothing on the shelf internally that does per-dataset tracking with score history. Katya and Gustavo are staffed on it at 50% each for a 6-week build: submission API, per-dataset boards (KonIQ, SPAQ, AVA to start), score history, and an Evalline hook so runs report in automatically. MVP lands mid-June per your milestone.

Compute is negligible — inference-only, a few titan-a100 nodes.

One ask back: for the leaderboard's v1 metric set I want to lock SRCC and PLCC per dataset and nothing else. Metric creep is how these things die.

Deshawn
